description_sq: Apartamenti ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 81.8 m2, nga te cilat 69.3 siperfaqe neto e apartamentit dhe 12.5 m2 siperfaqe te perbashketa. Apartamenti organizohet ne nje dhome ndenje dhe dy dhoma gjumi, nje ballkon dhe nje tualete. Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e peste dhe shitet bashke me post parkimi me cmim ekstra ne vleren 17 000 €.
title_en: We are selling a 2+1 apartment in Tirana Entry!
description_en: The apartment has a total area of ​​81.8 m2, of which 69.3 is the net area of ​​the apartment and 12.5 m2 is the common area. The apartment is organized in a living room and two bedrooms, a balcony and a toilet. The apartment is located on the fifth floor and is sold together with the parking post at an extra price of €17,000.
